Elastx.summary_note: Elastx is among the strongest sovereignty options in the EU cloud market for organisations whose primary threat model is non-EU legal overreach. As an independent, bootstrapped Swedish company with no US parent, no US subsidiary, and no non-EU institutional investors, it is structurally immune to the US CLOUD Act — a distinction it shares with very few providers. Its 'vanilla' OpenStack architecture with no proprietary overlay maximises portability and technical auditability. The platform is certified to ISO 27001:2022, 27017, 27018, and 14001, and operates three Stockholm-area data centres on 100% renewable energy. The primary sovereignty gaps are universal hardware-level constraints: all compute infrastructure relies on non-EU silicon (Intel/AMD CPUs, NVIDIA GPUs), and colocation arrangements may involve US-headquartered real estate operators. For EU public sector or regulated-industry workloads where CLOUD Act immunity is a hard requirement, Elastx represents a top-tier choice.
